rationale: McpClient.onError is the Go method mcp.Client.OnError; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration (undefined is the empty value or nil; the returned func is the dispose function). Closed as public-api-tested: exported from the public mcp package and no PiG binary calls it; test callers (go/types) are the proof.
